messages:
Maya (oncall): Heads-up — Lumina AdNet overnight scale run starts 2026-03-18 02:00 PT. I'm handing off coverage for 02:00-06:00 PT. Quick notes and risks below.

Sam T.: Taking 02:00-06:00 PT — will be watching dashboards and PagerDuty.

Maya (oncall): TL;DR:
- Expected peak ~8k RPS across /generate and /chat (single VIP customer).
- Contract SLA: p99 latency targets and an uptime clause (Lumina will divert traffic if errors spike).
- Autoscale is on but cold node spin-up may add ~15-30s.
- Known risk: burst fanout on /embed endpoints can blow up queue depth.

Jess - SRE: Which dashboards/alerts should I pin for quick triage?

Maya (oncall): Datadog dashboards: https://dd/redwood/lumina-adnet (pin this). Critical alerts configured: 
- REDWOOD/INF/LUMINAP99 > 800ms for 3m -> pager to oncall
- REDWOOD/INF/CPU_UTIL > 85% for 5m -> page infra
- REDWOOD/INF/QUEUE_DEPTH > 300 -> page backend

Rui (PM): FYI from Lumina CS: they expect immediate notif if error_rate > 0.5% (they may divert). Keep me in the loop.

Maya (oncall): Quick remediation playbook (short):
```
# short mitigations
1) scale_pool lumina-gpu-pool +2
2) reduce_canary lumina-canary -> 10% or disable
3) switch_fallback model=smaller-quantized
4) increase_workers on queue-consumer service by 2
```

deploy-bot: deploy lumina-hotfix v2026.3.18-rc2 -> started (canary 10%).

Jess - SRE: If canary running, what are rollback criteria?

Maya (oncall): Rollback if either:
- error_rate > 0.2% for 2 consecutive 1m windows OR
- p99 > 1000ms for 2 consecutive 1m windows.

Sam T.: I'll mute noisy non-actionable alerts and pin the three metrics. Also will set a reminder to check at 03:30 and 05:30 PT.

Sam T.: Quick cert check — who owns TLS cert rotation for lumina-adnet-prod? Don't want a surprise during scale.

Maya (oncall): Infra rotated certs yesterday; thumbprint ends in 3f:2b. I left the rotation note in infra-runbook -> see section \"certs/lumina-adnet\".

Rui (PM): Good. If we see any client errors > 0.5% I'll reach out to Lumina and propose traffic diversion plan.

Maya (oncall): Small note on traffic shaping: the routing policy will fallback to smaller model variant automatically if GPU pool capacity is exhausted — but this increases latency. Consider manual fallback if we see high error rates.

Jess - SRE: Acknowledged. I'll be standing by for deploy metrics and will escalate to infra if CPU stays >85%.

Sam T.: Oncall status: oncall-sam. I'll post a mid-run update at 05:30 PT and a final handback at 06:00 PT.

Maya (oncall): Thanks @Sam. I've added a short checklist to the thread and set notifications to #eng-oncall and #product-lumina. Handing off now. :white_check_mark:
